The '''Rancor's Claw''' was an elite [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They launched attacks on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] convoys in an attempt to lure the Republic into breaking the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], but were [[Battle of the Drexel system|quietly wiped out]] by the Republic in the [[Drexel system/Legends|Drexel system]].
